_comment: Feature 006 — the committed source of the in-app client changelog. Ingested at agent boot and via POST /admin/content/reingest. Each entry upserts by `slug` (idempotent); entries the seed no longer lists are PRUNED on ingest — seed-owned rows only, including pre-slug legacy rows — so a reset leaves exactly this file. An operator's live Admin -> Updates edit wins and is preserved; an unreadable/empty file never prunes. Client-facing register: keep it tester-friendly, no dev detail.

entries.title: The Vault page is now just the curated board
entries.body:
We removed the “SparkPoint’s own vault” card. SparkPoint is not launching its own vault on this network — the plan is to find strong vaults that already exist here, wrap them in SparkPoint’s own upgradeable wrapper, and bring them to the Vault page for you to use.

When the first vault is onboarded it will appear on the board by itself; until then the page says honestly that there is nothing to show. Deposits and withdrawals always stay in your own wallet.

entries.title: Under the hood: upgradeable curated-vault wrappers
entries.body:
We built the system that lets SparkPoint wrap a curated vault in its own upgradeable wrapper — so fees on gains stay future-proof and fixes can reach every wrapper at once.

Nothing changes on this network yet: there is still no curated vault live here, so there is nothing to deposit. When one goes live, the Vault page will show it with the full fee disclosure, and you will always sign from your own wallet.
